heading: Tuesday Night
text: Clear through midnight; a few high clouds late, mainly west of the Greens. Lows from the upper teens to mid 20s, except low to mid teens in northern cold hollows. Winds diminishing to light and variable.

heading: Wednesday
text: Sun filtering through high clouds. Highs from the upper 40s to mid 50s north, and mid to upper 50s in the south. South to southwest winds 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Wednesday Night
text: Partly cloudy early, then clearing. Lows from the upper 20s to mid 30s, with some mid 20s northeast, and some upper 30s near Lake Champlain. Winds becoming light, variable to south, except south 5 to 10 mph in the Champlain Valley.
